subject: Storage zones that improve kitchen flow
hook: Bespoke kitchens planned around the way you cook, not around standard cabinet sizes.
gbp:
A good kitchen is not just a set of cupboards in the right colour. It is food, crockery, cleaning, prep and cooking storage placed in the order you actually work, so pans sit by the hob, plates sit by the dishwasher and the bin sits by the sink.

SUPERIO designs and builds bespoke kitchens for homeowners who want that kind of layout made to fit their room exactly, including awkward corners, sloping ceilings and walls that are not quite square. We plan deep pan drawers, pull-out larders, cutlery inserts and corner storage where they will earn their keep, in matt, super matt, gloss, wood-effect or painted finishes, with soft-close hardware as standard.

Every kitchen is made in our own workshop in Hanley, quality-checked, then delivered and installed by our own team. We work with homeowners in Newcastle-under-Lyme and across the wider area.

It starts with a free, no-obligation design consultation, followed by an accurate measure and an itemised quote with no hidden costs. Tap the button below to find out more about our kitchens.
